CRITICAL: DATA ONLY. NO CONVERSATIONAL FILLER. START IMMEDIATELY WITH {.

- evidence MUST quote a real token from the provided telemetry (no invention).
- Focus on fastest safe recovery. Output strictly valid JSON.
